claims.statement: For a physical cross block C=A[I,J] with stable rank r>=8, the reviewed regularized determinant estimate implies integral_R |phi_Q(t)| dt <= sqrt(8)(sqrt(2pi)+2)/(sqrt(alpha)||C||_F), alpha=4/(pi^2 e^2), hence a bounded continuous output density.
For H=A-diag(A), some physical coordinate cut C=H[I,J] satisfies ||C||_F^2>=||H||_F^2/4 and sr(C)>=sr(H)/4.

Under the exact target hypotheses, if ||A-diag(A)||op<=1/4 then ||p_Q||inf<=pi sqrt(2); if ||A-diag(A)||op>1/4 and sr(A-diag(A))>=32 then Q has a continuous density with ||p_Q||inf<70. Therefore every counterexample must have off-diagonal operator norm>1/4 and off-diagonal stable rank<32.

Close the residual state ||A-diag(A)||op>1/4 and sr(A-diag(A))<32 by product-preserving finite-bank aggregation, covering the known star-plus-square/high-cardinality obstructions without reciprocal-minor loss.

partner_applied.application: Exact equality of interval-concentration suprema transfers the derived small-ball inequality from bounded finite-union product indicators to all admissible independent cap-one laws with no loss.
